title: Recovering an activation energy from noisy first-order kinetics
ask: BENCHMARK. Use Ea = 50 kJ/mol and A = 1.0e7 per second. The protocol's grid has axes named `noise` (the standard deviation of the added noise, as a fraction of c0) and `points` (time points per temperature) and includes the setting noise = 0.02, points = 20, with at least 400 repeats per setting. Declare a metric with id `ea_kj_per_mol` (kind mean; one value per repeat: the fitted activation energy in kJ/mol) and a metric with id `ea_covered` (kind proportion; one value per repeat: 1 when the 95 percent interval of Ea contains 50 kJ/mol, else 0).

answers.source: the true value the task sets; a weighted Arrhenius fit is unbiased to well inside this tolerance at 2 percent noise
the nominal coverage of a correct 95 percent interval
